nom: DRMTLGY Needle-less Growth Factor Firming and Lifting Serum

avis.texte: My face was doing really well while using dermalogica but I saw the reviews for this and thought "oh something better" . Well after a week of use my face looked like it had fallen, wrinkles ,wrinkles,wrinkles. Ladies over 50 don't waste your money.
I see no diffrence and wish is was as good as they say it is.

avis.titre: Wish the product was as good as their marketing!
avis.texte: Unfortunately, the product didn't produce even the slightest improvements. Tried other Dematolgy products in the past. I was hoping it might have improved. Sadly, my search will continue but not with this product.
Been using this a few weeks. No changes. Will continue until the bottle is finished. If I do notice a difference I will update.

i would definitely patch test this. burned my face, after appkucation, in a few minutes my face was red/flushed and was peeling similar to a sunburn the following days. unfortunate for my experience but i hope it works for others!

I use this with the DRMTLOGY Essential cleanser and Elemis Pro Collagen Marine Cream. I lost a lot of weight and am 47 years old so my face aged quite a bit very quickly. Tried many things from many different price points and I have noticed significant changes in less than a month with these products. More fullness and firmness and improved lines and wrinkles for sure!!

avis.titre: Love it but got a bad pump
avis.texte: Its a really nice serum but i also got a bad pump. The hole was never manufactured inbthe pump top. I ordered another directly and its fine.
Will be 2 weeks on Friday been using. I have not seen any changes but hopefully give more time.

avis.titre: Don't think I will buy again unless I start to see results
avis.texte: Been using this about a week now, don't see any difference yet. Also I find it very tacky ! I guess time will tell !!
I have been using this product for a couple of weeks. I've used it faithfully morning and night. I definitely can tell a difference in my skin tone.

I wanted to love this and was hoping for great results, but after using this morning and evening for almost 2 months, I have seen no improvement on my face and neck. I will not be purchasing another bottle. This is too expensive to see no improvement.

avis.titre: I will definitely buy this again
avis.texte: I cannot use retinol it leaves my face feeling irritated and burned . So I tried this as a retinol alternative & I wished I had started using this long ago. I started using it at night after cleaning my face before the peptide night cream and I can see such a difference in the sagging I was seeing .

The pump never worked and should never have made it out of test marketing. If purchasing try to see of yours works in the store before taking. I am trying it and it is tacky so I let dry before adding moisturizer. Too early to tell if it will help.

I think so people are confused by this product. This is one of rhe most aforable per oz growth factors on the market. Yes its vegan. But this is not going to moisturize like a serum for that purpose. Growth factors send sinals to your skin to repair. Results take months!!

I truly wanted to love this after the reviews. I have mature early 50s skin. I cannot justify paying this much for a product that I use twice a day and does NOT last long. It is much more expensive than a few other brands that deliver the same or better results. Causing me ti go back to what is more affordable and JUST as EFFECTIVE! So, my opinion is to give the less expensive face serums a try and you will see that more expensive does not mean better quality or delivers what it claims. Best if luck!

avis.titre: Love the way it makes my skin feel
avis.texte: I've only been usung this for a week and i wake up with my skin feeling amazing and plump and smooth. I bought the eye cream which i love equally too. I'll be starting their night cream soon, I ran to Ulta to buy it.

I want to give this one 5 stars, but the pump was broke. I'm still using the product. I grabbed the needless serum and the nignt moisturizer with this about 3 weeks ago and my skin is thanking me. I hope that Ulta gets ALL of the DRMTLGY products becuase I would use them exclusively! So glad these are finally available in store!

I recently started using the Needle-less Growth Factor Serum. Within the first two weeks, people were asking what skincare products I was using. They said I looked younger, with a glow to my skin. I have noticed an overall significant improvement in my skin texture and firmness. I am very impressed with the results.
I have been using DRMTLGY's Needle.-less GF since the summer and have seen an improvement with the lines. Also, it is acne friendly. Im so happy to see it gracing Ulta's shelves.

I've only just started using the serum and I can say that the texture of the serum is very pleasant on the face without irritation. I'm expecting good results because all your products are perfect for me. 😊

The Serum goes on so smooth. It makes my face feel like a baby's butt while filling in all my wrinkles and fine lines. I have this on subscription and use every night. Ive seen improvements in just a few weeks.
This serum has truly smoothed and firmed up my skin. I get compliments regularly on it. Thank you!! Love it!!

This serum packs a punch. I have extremely sensitive skin, that is reddish pink. I have used this for a few months with zero irritation. The texture of my skin has changed and I am beyond thrilled with my results.

I am on my second bottle of this and can't say enough good things about it. The science behind it is why I ordered. I have tried the TNS Growth Factor from Skin Medica and I will say I believe this serum has given me better results at a fraction of the cost for the TNS. My wrinkles have significantly decreased and my skin overall just appears firmer. Will continue to purchase. It is a little pricey but considering all the benefits I believe its worth the price!

I love all DRMTLGY products and this is no exception. Every time I try a new brand, I always come back to this one! They are clean, no fragrance go on beautifully and Iove them all! I'm 60 and my skin looks really good. I combine this with peptide cream in the day. I use growth serum at night.

I just started using the Needle-less Growth Factor Serum. I was surprised how lightweight it was. It doesn't feel heavy or tacky on my face. If it performs like my other DRMTLGY products, Tinted Moisturizer with SPF, Pumpkin Enzyme Maske, Brightening Eye Masks, and the all-timt GOAT, Luminous Eye Corrector with SPF I know I won't be disappointed.
Don't hesitate! Buy it!!! Within a week of using it twice a day people were complimenting my skin and asking what I was doing differently.
On my second bottle and just ordered another. Skin feels amazing. I use 2x a day.
After only a couple of weeks using the needle-less growth serum I can notice a change in my skin. I use other DRMTLGY products as well and would highly recommend this product/skin care line.

This stuff is amazing, just got a second bottle, love the way it makes my skin feel, absorbs quickly & leaves a soft silky feeling, been using this for awhile & I definitely notice a difference in my skin, less wrinkles/lines with a nice glow to my skin, sometimes it's all I wear when going out!!!!
Absolutely love this needless growth serum. My face looks greater than before 🙌 thank DRMTLGY for making this amazing serum
I started using this product a few weeks ago and can already see a reduction in fine lines.

avis.titre: Transformed my skin with Peptide Night Cream
avis.texte: I've only used it for 2 weeks, but this and the Peptide Night Cream have totally transformed my skin!! I have sensitive, combo, acne prone and hormonal skin. I'm so glad I found this line. I can't wait to try other things!

Silky and has transformed my skin. It's radiant and buttery smooth! I've used it with the peptide night cream as my first order from here about 2 weeks ago. My skin has never looked this good!! I even told so many people about these products in 2 weeks before I even knew about the referring rewards 😂😅 No makeup in this pic. That's how awesome this line is!!!

Well, this is one of those products that has the payoff with long consistent use. I've been using it for a couple of months now and I do think my skin overall looks healthier and bouncier. I used to only at night and then decided to start using it morning at night and I just really like how it feels when it goes on and the immediate plumping effect. But overtime my skin has a more resilient view to it. I'm less prone to fine lines. I'm not sure yet how well it affects laxity. I feel like copper peptides (from a different brand) andDRMTLGY's neck serum have had the more positive effects in that area.

I have used almost one full bottle of this the needle-less growth factor serum and it has been a game changer. The wrinkles around my lips have diminished and my face feels softer. I have already ordered my second bottle. I also use it on my forehead and around my eyes. I wish I had taken a before and "since".
this is a great product! I could see immediate results in the texture of my skin and the appearance of rosacea.

I've only been using this serum for the past two weeks, so this is a first impressions type of review. I have rosacea and a small patch of perioral dermatitis. The rosacea does not react to the serum, the dermatitis does, so I now avoid that area. The rest of the face/neck and chest feel lovely. It sinks in well and leaves no greasy finish or film. I can't talk about anti aging benefits just yet, only about the appearance of the skin. So far I will repurchase
This feels great on my skin. I use at night. My skin feels soft and nourished and looks healthier after a few weeks. Looking to continued results.

I am halfway through my first bottle of Needle-less and I have to say, I see a difference in the intensity of my forehead lines! I bought this product on a recommendation but wasn't honestly expecting any noticeable results, as been the case with most other products. But I'm pleased to say this one from Drmtlgy is different in a really good way! The price point is also right, which is a huge plus in the facial care/serum space. I will be keeping this product in my face care regimen for sure.

I've been using the product for one month and love it. This lightweight, fragrance-free serum definitely has shown to be effective. I see improved elasticity and firmness. I especially notice significant firming at the jowls, jawline and under the neck. It is non-drying, absorbs quickly and I truly appreciate the fragrance-free formulation. My skin really feels smoother and looks firmer only four weeks. Already purchased a second bottle.

I absolutely love the Needles Growth Factor Serum. At first, I was a bit concerned because I have very sensitive skin and suffer from rosacea but the serum is actually very gentle and didn't cause any redness. I've been using it for about a month and I can already seen how much my skin has improved! And I'm not the only one! My daughter, who lives in Italy and hadn't seen in person since May, was very impressed with my skin. She asked if I had changed something in my routine because my skin looks firmer than before! At 59 my biggest issues is the loss of firmness especially in my chin area. This serum is really making a difference. I use it along with the needless serum and the results are real! Couldn't be happier!
As for my experience, I'm loving this product. I was able to see fast effects on my skin and it's not greasy on the skin and I don't feel any flim-like coating on my face. I'm a super fan.
I have been using this serum for a couple of months now. I have noticed a huge difference in the texture and tone of my skin. Love it!
used this for 2 weeks and loving how smooth my face is. It was out for a while but now it's back so I grab 2 immediately.

I'm living this serum with the needleless serum. I also use it at night before my retinol & feel like my skin is less reactive because of that. It is more smooth & less likely to peal. So glad I bought it to try!

I've been using this for a week or so now and I like the consistency and the way it soaks into my skin nicely. I have not used it long enough for results yet, but I do like the feel of this serum and how it preps my skin.
I had noticeable results after one use. The texture of my face felt better the next day. I'm excited to see what the results will be in a few weeks.

avis.titre: Growth serum: so far, so good
avis.texte: Accidentally ordered the Growth Serum as I thought I was reordering the regular Needle-less tincture. Nice texture and absorption and great pump container. Not noticeably different than the original Needle-less product, but I'll likely reorder to follow its progress for at least two months. If no change, then I may go back to the original.

I am a skin care junkie and at 67 years old I've tried hundreds of products...THIS BEATS THEM ALL! I just started using it and have already noticed a difference in my skin this is no lie! Get this powerful bottle in your hands ladies...especially for you with mature skin...this will not disappoint!

I've only been using it for 2 weeks, and I already love it. The texture is pleasing and hydrating, and I like the way my skin looks with it on. Time will tell, I'm following the recommendation to layer in the LA serum a couple of nights a week. My skincare obsessed colleague noticed how dewy-not-shiny my face looked when I was only wearing Needless Growth Factor and sunscreen. Guess what's going to be in someone's stocking this year? ;)

I'm sticking with this product although the pump is terrible. Pump, pump, pump pump before any product comes out. I'll try another bottle when this one is gone and if there's still a problem I won't be purchasing again. Too bad because I really do like this serum.

avis.titre: Idk that my skin needed this!
avis.texte: I'm a 59F, post menopausal, had oily skin for most of my life until the end of menopause. I now have combination skin. I use many of their products so I'd thought I'd give this a try. My skin absolutely LOVES this serum!! It's so light and my skin just drinks this in. I've added it to my routine and also to my subscriptions. I encourage everyone to give it a try and see your skin transform too.
The need-less growth serum is great!! It really moisturizes your face!

I have tried a few different serums and many are thin and watery (this may be by design as many are supposed to be hydrating, etc) but come the colder weather, I love to use this serum! It is a bit thicker than the others I have used and feels great going on. It feels a bit more 'protective', and soothing when the weather is cold and the air inside is dry.

Have only been using for a short while but I am excited to see the results, my skin looks better, however I have been using and discovering their other products that are impressing me as well! Disappointed it is out of stock for the Black Friday sale though!!!

I've been using this serum for a few weeks and I'm honestly impressed! The texture feels silky and absorbs quickly without any sticky feeling. My skin looks smoother and firmer, especially around the cheeks and forehead. It gives that "just had a facial" glow. I love that it works like professional treatments but without needles!

I'm truly enjoying incorporating the Needle-Less Growth Factor serum into my skincare routine. I've noticed that the fine lines and wrinkles on my forehead appear smoother and more plumped whenever I use it. This is definitely a product that will remain a staple in my routine. The performance is impressive and outperforms other growth factor serums on the market, many of which are much more expensive. If you're looking to elevate your skincare game, this would be a fantastic addition.

I've been using the Needle-less GF Serum for just under a month, and I really like it so far! It's lightweight and layers perfectly under my sunscreen and makeup. I have sensitive skin and haven't had any irritation or reactions while using it, which is a big plus. Overall, it feels gentle, smooth, and effective—I'm happy with it!

avis.titre: A lovely new addition to my skincare routine
avis.texte: I've been using the needles growth factor for a few weeks now, it's a little early to tell if it's helping yet, but it glides onto the skin and isn't tacky. The price point is very attractive also, I've tried the "medical grade skincare" ones and I feel this is better, it's nicer to use and I've subscribed so I'm committed to seeing if this helps, thanks J x

I am pleased with the Growth Factor Serum. It has been about two weeks since I changed to the serum from a different company product. I feel my skin feels plumper and smoother. It seems to work well with my other make up products as well. I also added the night time cream and I am pleased with that product as well. Excellent products and bonus with the reasonable price point too.
I received the product, have been using it and I've noticed my skin looks really good. I would buy again. I'm 54, so anything that makes me look good, I like!

I've only used this product about a little over a week. I haven't used foundation in a couple of days and my husband said have you done anything different. I said I'm trying this new serum. He said keep using it. So I will re-order.
So far I am really liking this serum. I just started my 2nd bottle and I'm excited to really start seeing results.
I've only been using this product for a couple of weeks & so far liking it. I use it after the needless serum.

I love this stuff! It's crazy that I've only been using it for a few weeks and I can already see improvements. My skin feels smoother, tighter, and more hydrated. Definitely a must to continue using as I come up on my 53rd birthday, and I'll definitely buy it again.

avis.titre: Best serum I have ever used
avis.texte: I love growth serum. I apply to my face immediately after Needless serum. Only 1½pumps and my face feels smooth, my complexion brighter. I use both am and pm. I am on my 2nd bottle as it is so amazing

I'm 76 and have been blessed with pretty good skin for my age. I have been using Growth Factor for a couple of weeks now and I cannot believe the improvement in firmness, pore size overall texture and tone of my skin! I have gone from using a 4-5 step (other brand) regimen to 2-3. Just trying to decide which of your other items to introduce. Your products are amazing!
I really like the new growth serum. It feels light and refreshing when I put it on. I use it morning and night.

avis.titre: The glow and firmness I was looking for
avis.texte: I've been using the Needle-less® Growth Factor Serum from DRMTLGY for a few weeks now, and it has honestly become one of my favorite skincare products. The texture is silky and lightweight — it glides on effortlessly, absorbs quickly, and leaves no sticky residue. From the first few days, my skin started to feel firmer and more hydrated. After about two weeks, I noticed a visible improvement in overall tone and smoothness, especially around my eyes and smile lines. What I really love is that it gives results without irritation or heaviness — just that healthy, plump look that makes your skin glow even without makeup. It layers beautifully under moisturizer and SPF, and I can tell it helps my skin look more youthful and refreshed. The "needle-less" name truly fits — it feels like a professional treatment in a bottle, but gentle enough for daily use. I'll definitely keep this serum in my routine.

I'm 44 and don't use Botox. So I've been searching for a serum that will soften my forehead wrinkles. This has definitely helped. In the morning after putting on at night my forehead looks softer and hydrated.
Love the new growth serum. Please work on the pump as that broke soon after I started using it!

I have been using the needless growth serum for approx 8 weeks. The results are ridiculous. My skin is plump, my pores are smaller and I have a glow that comes from within. I am 53 soon to be 54 and my skin has never looked better. I am on auto ship because I never want to miss a day. Total home run. Would love to submit before and after pics. Customer for life.
Have been using this product for a couple of weeks and my face is much more moisturized and believe my wrinkles are less noticeable

avis.titre: A total must-have in any skincare routine
avis.texte: This serum is absolutely amazing! From the very first uses, my skin felt firmer, smoother, and more radiant. It has a lightweight texture that absorbs quickly without leaving any sticky feeling , perfect for layering under makeup or using at night.
So far I've been using this product for about 1 week and I like it so far. Hope to see more.
Started using this a week now. So soon to tell but there's no irritation on my skin. Hopefully it will do wonders for my mature skin.

Been using this product for a couple of weeks now traded it out for the needleless serum. I use that in the morning and this one in the evening the black packaging makes it easy to add to my nighttime routine along with my HR eye cream. Absorbs quickly.
This has been a game changer for my skin!My skin feels tighter and smoother
This product is amazing. The difference in my skin is astonishing. Thank you!!
I love this product! I've only been using for a few weeks and can already see a difference.
So far I'm loving this new Growth factor. I love all Drmtlgy products actually!!
Enjoying Growth Factor serum so far. Been using a couple of weeks. Little frustrating that the pump was broken on the product bottle. But am liking the serum so far.

The needless growth factor serum is one of the best products DRMTLGY makes. I have been using it since it first came out and my overall skin texture has improved significantly. In the past I have used Skinmedica TNS and this product far surpasses it. With the added benefits of good ingredients including gluten free this product is a winner!
I love this serum. It's not sticky when it dries and my skin looks luminous!
I love this and bought more; I feel like I'm doing great things for my skin— and any potential eye wrinkles! Thank you!!
This one makes my face look skin tight, it's my new favorite product!!!
I just started using this serum about two weeks ago. I use it in the morning under my makeup. I can see a smother, supple skin. I will continue to purchase this product as part of my daily routine.

Been using this serum for a few weeks, my skin feels smoother and a bit firmer. It absorbs so fast and doesn't leave that sticky feel. Love the clean design of DRMTLGY products and the fact that it's backed by science. So good!
It has a beautiful texture and my skin absorbs it so well! I have used the other Drmtlgy serum but this one also is pretty good! Very happy!

I have used the needleless serum for quite some time and think it is a great product. However, I am not certain what magical sorcery this is, but I saw an improvement in my fine lines so quickly! Absolutely loving this product!

At 52, I have pretty good skin to begin with. No deep wrinkles. Just the beginning of fine lines, pores more prominent, and a little droop. Mainly I've been using this in hope of combatting the droop around my mouth (marionette lines). I'm approaching 8 weeks of consistent daily (sometimes twice a day) use and I am starting to see improvement with the droop. I've ordered and will keep it up. I love how it glides on and absorbs quickly. The fine lines temporarily go away as it's very hydrating.

I love it !! It'll just be 2 months, and I can tell a difference. My skin just looks extra healthy and has a great glow. I wish I had taken a before picture- but I'm really happy with the results. It's a new favorite.

Haven't been using this for long but I can already tell a difference!! I use it every morning and every night on top of the needless serum! Trying to avoid Botox and I think I found the perfect pair to avoid it! Definitely recommend!
Love, Love this product! One pump goes on whole face. I love the results in the short amount of time!

've been using the Needle-less® Growth Factor Serum and I'm honestly so impressed. The texture is silky and absorbs quickly without leaving any sticky feeling. My skin looks smoother, firmer, and so radiant — like it's glowing from within. I love how healthy and refreshed my face looks every morning. This serum truly feels like a boost of life for my skin!
This was the serum that my skin needed. After using it only for 10 days twice a day I can already see the results. My skin is more hydrated and smooth

I have been using this for about a month and I've already noticed results, less discoloration, more hydrated skin. I've been consistently using a different growth factor serum for over a year and did not have nearly the results as I've already seen switching to this one!

I've only been using this product for 10 days and I can already see a difference. The smooth texture and brightness of my skin is noticeable. The serum is light and instantly gives the skin a glow. I have sensitive dry skin and have not had any issues with my skin. Don't hesitate, just give it a try.!
I have been using the growth factor serum without needles for weeks, day and night and I have noticed really great changes, more hydration, firming and shine on my face!
I love this serum-it spreads easily, absorbs beautifully and layers with no problem. After two weeks my skin looks a little plumper and healthier! I am definitely sticking with this.
Only been using this about week now but my skin looks so much better! I use at night with the Needle-less , will definitely be keeping this in my skin care routine!
So happy with this new product works beautifully with the needleless
I cannot get my dispenser to work on the Growth Factor Serum.

I love the dispenser and the fact that it doesn't have a lid. Easy access! It's like a cross between a serum and a lotion. I use 2 pumps morning and night, and I feel a difference after 2ish weeks. My skin feels softer, looks plumper and my pores aren't as prominent. New fav DRMTLGY product!
The needle-less growth factor serum works great! It's only been about ten days and my skin feels and looks fabulous. It's soft and the fine lines are disappearing. Highly recommend.

From the first day I used this growth serum, I knew it was working. The very next day I woke up with "purging acne"(even a couple of cystic nodules). I know this is to be expected for some of us and it doesn't last forever. I have very sensitive skin and I am 65, so I haven't has skin turnover this fast since I was a teenager (although, I never had acne then, just an occasional blemish). I splurged on this item and do believe this is outperforming my Ordinary growth serum. Worth the price, if you can be patient through a potential breakout.
I just starting using this serum and my skin is already plumper.
I have been using this serum for almost a month and I can already see a difference around my eyes. It's light weight and dries quick. Wonderful product!
This serum is lightweight and goes on smoothly. I apply it before my tinted moisturizer they compliment each other nicely.
